title: Crash and recovery around the proposal-to-decision path (section 44, D-2026-110)
note: PCR1-PCR12: a durable proposal stranded by a crash at any append is taken up by resubmitting it -- admitted, dispatched, its live dispatch resumed by the same worker identity only, its completed attempt verified from records that agree -- under the policy in force, never for an EXTERNAL tool, and its decision returned rather than made twice, and only for the same check's report.

mutations.name: PCR1_a_resubmission_only_reports
mutations.replace: if True or not (state in (TaskState.CREATED, TaskState.VALIDATED)
mutations.rationale: the defect itself: a durable proposal stranded by a crash is reported forever and never reaches a decision

mutations.name: PCR2_a_live_dispatch_is_dispatched_again
mutations.rationale: the attempt a dead dispatcher began is dispatched a second time, which the queue refuses: the proposal stalls behind its own lease

mutations.name: PCR3_any_worker_takes_over_a_live_lease
mutations.rationale: another worker identity takes over a lease it was never granted and runs work leased to someone else

mutations.name: PCR4_the_queue_is_not_reconciled_before_resuming
mutations.rationale: a lapsed lease is read as still dispatched, so work whose lease ran out long ago is never taken up again

mutations.name: PCR5_an_external_effect_is_resumed
mutations.rationale: a tool declaring EXTERNAL effects is re-run after a crash, repeating an effect nobody here can see or undo

mutations.name: PCR6_a_completed_task_is_verified_from_records_that_disagree
mutations.find: if not artifacts or self._check_declared_outputs(outputs, artifacts):
mutations.rationale: a completion whose execution record and capture disagree is verified on resume, with an obligation discharged on an agreement that does not hold

mutations.name: PCR7_a_completed_task_is_left_without_its_verdict
mutations.rationale: a task completed before the crash waits forever for a verifier nobody runs

mutations.name: PCR8_the_policy_is_not_asked_on_resume
mutations.find:
actor=submitter, target=task.task_id)
        decision.raise_if_denied()
        if recorded is not None
mutations.replace:
actor=submitter, target=task.task_id)
        if recorded is not None
mutations.rationale: a resumed attempt runs under the rules of the moment it was first submitted, not those in force when it runs

mutations.name: PCR9_a_validated_task_is_validated_again
mutations.find:
if task.state is TaskState.CREATED:
            # Validation is a real gate
mutations.replace:
if True:
            # Validation is a real gate
mutations.rationale: a task resumed after validation is moved VALIDATED -> VALIDATED, which the machine refuses: the proposal stalls

mutations.name: PCR10_an_enqueued_job_is_enqueued_twice
mutations.rationale: a job already in the queue is enqueued again under its own id, which the queue refuses: the proposal stalls

mutations.name: PCR11_a_decided_record_is_decided_again
mutations.rationale: a decision already in the log is attempted a second time on resume, and the path fails on its own verdict

mutations.name: PCR12_a_decision_on_another_report_is_returned
mutations.rationale: a verdict given on one check's report is handed back as the answer to a decision on another
